# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.

[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Vectron X – the next dimension of rail technology

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]
[bx-overview-panoramic-city-skyline-is485896260-xcelerator-shape-hero-2560x1440]

points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

Deep in the Amazon, a cooperative partnered with Natura to extract essential oils from native
plants. We brought a digital twin to their extraction process, cutting energy and water use while
boosting income for the local community by 60%.

# Big Timer

Big Timer is a fullscreen countdown timer for workshops, presentations and meetings in your browser

Please go to [bigtimer.net][1] in a browser with javascript enabled to use Big Timer.

## Do you have Javascript enabled?

Press CMD+Shift+R on a Mac or CTRL+Shift+R on Windows to force-reload the page. If that doesn't
help, please clear your browser history for bigtimer.net.:

### Chrome
1. Press CMD+Y on a Mac or CTRL-H on Windows
2. Search bigtimer in your history
3. Select all instances of Big Timer in the search results
4. Press the three dots on the right
5. Remove the website from Chrome's history

### Firefox
1. Press CTRL-H on Windows or, on a Mac, go to History > Show all history
2. Search bigtimer in your history
3. Select all instances of Big Timer in the search results
4. Right-click
5. Click Remove pages

### Safari on MacOS
1. Press CMD+Y
2. Search bigtimer in your history
3. Select all instances of Big Timer in the search results
4. Click Edit
5. Click Delete

### Safari on iOS
1. Go to your homescreen
2. Tap Settings
3. Scroll down and tap Safari
4. Tap Advanced at the bottom
5. Tap Website Data
6. Find bigtimer.net
7. Swipe left on bigtimer.net, press delete

If you don't see Big Timer in your history, javascript may be disabled in your browser after all.

[1]: https://www.bigtimer.net

needs at a fair price in the shortest possible time.

## What is an Online Clock?

[Online Clock][62], also known as a **web clock**, is a tool that displays real-time time in your
browser, allowing users to view the current hour, minute, and second without installing any software
or using a physical clock.

The **Online Clock** by **ClockLy** works via the Internet and syncs with your device's system
timezone, ensuring you always stay accurate with the time at your current location or workplace.

## Outstanding Features of the Online Clock:

- Displays the current time in digital, analog, or flip styles.

- Runs continuously and updates every second without requiring refresh.

- No app installation needed, just access the website to use it.

- Full-screen mode is available, ideal for presentations, teaching, group meetings, or personal use.

## When Should You Use an Online Clock?

- When you don’t have a physical clock nearby.

- When you want to display time clearly on a large screen (TV, projector, etc.).

- When working in groups, teaching, hosting competitions, or needing a visual time interface for
better task management.

## Three Display Modes of the Online Clock

Here are the 3 display modes of the online clock offered by [ClockLy][63]. When using the tool, you
can choose between three different display styles to match your habits and usage purposes. These
include:

### 1. Digital Clock

- This is the most common mode, displaying time clearly in hour : minute : second format.

- Ideal for users who need to track time accurately to the second.

- Sharp and easy-to-read interface, especially useful in scenarios requiring precise time tracking
such as exams, workouts, or teamwork.

### 2. Analog Clock

- This mode simulates a traditional clock with hour, minute, and second hands.

- Offers a familiar and easy-to-read design for those used to wristwatches.

- Suitable for classrooms, meetings, or formal environments where a sleek, eye-friendly clock
interface is preferred.

### 3. Flip Clock

- Flip Clock blends a retro and modern style, using distinctive “flipping” effects each time the
display changes.

- Unique and visually appealing interface.

- Perfect for full-screen presentations in events, classrooms, or as a stylish time display in
offices, cafés, livestreams, etc.

If you're looking for a **stopwatch tool** (time counting), check out the [Online Stopwatch][64]
page – super convenient and easy to use.

## Advantages of Using Multiple Clock Modes

**The flexibility of the three modes allows you to:**

- Personalize to your preferences: go for digital if you like modern, analog for a classic feel, and
flip if you want something creative and fun.

- Adapt to each situation: for example, use analog in a classroom so students can better visualize
time, while digital works great for task and time management.

- Present professionally when screen sharing or projecting: especially in full-screen mode,

timezone, ensuring you always stay accurate with the time at your current location or workplace.

- Runs continuously and updates every second without requiring refresh.

- No app installation needed, just access the website to use it.

- Full-screen mode is available, ideal for presentations, teaching, group meetings, or personal use.

- When you don’t have a physical clock nearby.

- This is the most common mode, displaying time clearly in hour : minute : second format.

## Display your countdown on any screen

Create a countdown once, then open it as a full-page display on a desktop, laptop, tablet, phone,
classroom smart board, office monitor, or event screen. It's a simple way to keep a date visible at
home, at work, in class, or during an event.

### Full-page display links

Open your countdown on a clean, screen-friendly page built for viewing, presenting, or displaying.

### Works across devices

Use your countdown on phones, tablets, laptops, desktops, smart boards, and larger screens.

### QR codes and embeds

Use QR codes for printed reminders or embed a live countdown on a website, blog, landing page, or
event page.

## Create a countdown timer for any event

### Any Event, Any Occasion

Track holidays, trips, launches, birthdays, and more. See the days, hours, minutes, and seconds
remaining.

### Make It Your Own

Customize colors or backgrounds so your timer matches the theme of your event.

### Share with Anyone

Share a link so friends, family, or your team can see the same countdown in real time.

## Simple tools, polished countdowns

### Custom themes

Pick gradients, solid colors, or upload an image to match your event.

### Live preview

See every change instantly so your countdown looks right before you share it.

### Shareable links

Send an editor link to update the event or a viewer link for read-only timers.

### Works on any device

Your countdown adapts to phones, tablets, and desktops.

## How your countdown link works

Understanding how we keep your countdown safe and shareable.

### Clean, short links

We create a simple, short URL for your countdown. No long, confusing links to share with friends and
family.

### No personal info needed

We don't require an account, email, or any personal information. Just create your countdown and
share it.

## Frequently asked questions

Is my data safe?

Yes! We only store your countdown details (title, date, message, and colors) to generate a clean,
short link. We don't require any personal information, account, or login. The information you enter
is only what you choose to share.

Can someone change my countdown after I share it?

No. Once you copy your link, the countdown settings are locked in that URL. Recipients will see
exactly what you created. If you share the "editor" link, they can make their own version, but that
won't change your original link.

Do I need to create an account?

No account needed! Just create your countdown, copy the link, and share it. Everything works right
in your browser without signing up.

What's the difference between a display link and an editor link?

The display link opens a clean, full-page countdown that's meant for viewing on a phone, tablet,
laptop, desktop, smart board, office monitor, or event screen. The editor link lets you return and
make changes to your countdown later, so keep that link private.

Is this really free?

Yes, completely free. Create countdowns, add messages, choose colors, gradients, or upload photos,
and share links — all at no cost, with no account required.

Why does my countdown show the wrong time?

Countdowns run entirely in your browser using your device's local time, so they automatically adjust
to wherever the viewer is. If you and a friend are in different time zones, you'll both see the
countdown calculated correctly for your own clocks — no setup needed. If the time looks off,
double-check that your device's date and time are set correctly.

How do I embed a countdown on my website?

After setting up your countdown, click "Share Timer Only" and then "Get Embed Code." You'll get a
short snippet of HTML that you can paste into any webpage, blog, or website builder. The countdown
will display live inside an iframe and keep ticking for anyone who visits your page.

Do my countdown links expire?

No — your shared links do not expire. Once you create and share a countdown, that link will keep
working indefinitely. The countdown will simply show zero and display your completion message once
the date has passed.

Can I use my own photo as the background?

Yes — and it's completely free. In the background section of the builder, switch to the "Image" tab.
You can paste in a direct image URL or upload a photo from your device. Uploaded photos are stored
securely so anyone who opens your shared link will see the same image.

What happens when the countdown reaches zero?

When the timer hits zero, a confetti celebration fires and your completion message appears. The
default message is "It's time to celebrate!" but you can write your own in the "Completion message"
field before sharing. Anyone viewing your countdown at that moment will see the celebration
automatically.

# csTimer version 2025.08.18 - Professional Speedcubing/Training Timer

translation

## Introduction

csTimer is a professional timing program designed for Rubik's cube speedsolvers, it provides:
* Amounts of scramble algorithms, including **all WCA official events**, varieties of twisty
  puzzles, **training scramble** for specific sub steps (e.g. **F2L, OLL, PLL, ZBLL**, and can
  filter cases), etc
* Plenty of statistics functions, it supports **time-split timing**; **Any number of sessions**,
  session split/merge, etc.
* Varieties of solver, such as **Cross, Xcross, 2x2x2 face, Skewb Face, SQ1 shape**, for learning or
  training these sub steps.
* Other auxiliary tools, such as scramble image, 8-second inspection (voice) alert, metronome,
  batch-scramble generator, etc.
* Backup function, For avoiding data missing, you can backup your solves to local files, csTimer's
  server or Google storage.

csTimer supports most of modern desktop browsers, on mobile phone and tablet PC, you can add csTimer
to your home screen, and it will work as a native APP.

csTimer takes advantage of browser cache, which consumes traffic only when you open it for the first
time, after that, csTimer is able to work without network connection (except for functions like
backup)

### Copyright

csTimer is an open source software that follows the GPLv3. If you have any suggestions or comments
on csTimer, please submit it [here][1]

Written by: [Shuang Chen (cs0x7f@gmail.com)][2]

UI designed by: [Yue Zhang (liebe7@126.com)][3]

## Basic functions
* **How to start timing** - Hold the space bar (or both of left and right Ctrl keys, or touch the
  screen on mobile devices) and wait for the timer to turn green, the timer will start timing once
  the space bar is released, press any key to stop timing and the solving time will be record.
* **UI description** - There are 6 buttons near the logo of csTimer: option, export, scramble, list
  times, donate, tools, click on the **scramble**, **list times**, **tool** to open the
  corresponding function panel.
* **Scramble panel** - In the Scramble panel, you can select scramble type, set scramble length and
  case filter (if available), review previous scramble, generate next scramble.
* **List times panel** - In the list times panel, you can open session manager by clicking
  "Session", select/add/delete sessions, empty session by the selector and the button next to, then
  you can view the current single/average, best single/average, and the full time list.
* **Tools panel** - In the tool panel, you can select specific auxiliary functions, including
  scramble image, scramble generators, solvers, other kinds of statistics, etc.

## Keyboard shortcut

─────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Alt + p/m/c/s        │Scramble type to pyra/megaminx/clock/skewb                                    
─────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Alt + i              │Scramble type to input                                                        
─────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Alt + d              │Remove all solves in current session                                          
─────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Alt + left/right     │Display last/next scramble                                                    
─────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## Basic functions

## Keyboard shortcut

## Option details
* **Hide All Elements When Timing**. Hide logo and all panels when timing.
* **use milliseconds**. Display the millisecond digit, no matter whether it is checked, the internal
  timing accuracy of csTimer is 1 millisecond.
* **time format**. Time format to display.
* **Auto Export (per 100 solves)**. If checked, csTimer will export the solves automatically per 100
  solves to the specified place, local file, csTimer server, or Google Storage.
* **Import non-latest data**. If you've uploaded multiple backups, you can import from one of the up
  to 10 most recently uploaded backups, if you accidentally upload an empty backup, this option will
  help you retrieve your solves.
* **Hint messages in logo**. cstimer's Logo will serve as an information display panel that prompts
  for a variety of information you may be interested in, such as breaking PB.
* **Show Avg Label**. Two lines of labels are displayed below the the main timer, the current two
  averages, ao5 and ao12 by default.
* **Zoom**. You can adjust sizes of all elements by this option.
* **select timer's font**. Font of the main timer.
* **UI design is**. You can switch ui design to material-like, or hide shadows by this option.
* **UI style is**. Switch between desktop and mobile views.
* **Scramble panel display style**. Make scramble panel embedded into background.
* **Statistics panel display style**. Make list times panel embedded into background.
* **Tools panel display style**. Make tool panel embedded into background.
* **background image opacity**. Opacity of the background image.
* **background image**. You can select your own image as the background image, however, only https
  urls are available due to security constraint of the browser.
* **timer size**. Set the size of main timer.
* **use small font after decimal point**. Use a smaller font size after the digital point in main
  timer.
* **select color theme**. Select color schemes of csTimer. Click csTimer's logo to show more color
  schemes.
* **use mouse timer**. Use mouse to start timer, keyboard-trigger will also be available.
* **use WCA inspection**. Enable WCA inspection procedure, which is a 15-second countdown, auto
  +2/DNF penalty will also be enabled if you inspecting more than 15 seconds.
* **voice alert of WCA inspection**. Alert at 8s/12s of inspection, to simulate the alert from judge
  in WCA competitions.
* **Voice volume**. Voice level of the alert above.
* **entering in times with**. csTimer is able to add solves by several ways, it supports manually
  input, automatically record from a stackmat timer, connect to a bluetooth smart cube or play
  virtual Rubik's cube, besides keyboard timing.

  batch-scramble generator, etc.

  server or Google storage.

to your home screen, and it will work as a native APP.

  "Session", select/add/delete sessions, empty session by the selector and the button next to, then
  you can view the current single/average, best single/average, and the full time list.
* **Tools panel** - In the tool panel, you can select specific auxiliary functions, including
  scramble image, scramble generators, solvers, other kinds of statistics, etc.

## Why Choose Cousign?

Being in the digital sign business for over 15 years means Cousign founders Chris & Steve Trottier
know safety signs. Our goal is to provide simple and effective signage for businesses to improve
safety around the workplace through our cost-effective counting signs that are great for employees
and business owners alike. Here are some of our unique offerings:
Custom Safety Scoreboard Signs
Don't see a scoreboard design that works for you? We provide custom safety scoreboard solutions that
are sure to match your vision & accomplish your goals.
Design Your Sign Online
Our [online design tool][73] allows you to choose a suitable display configuration and customize the
text and graphics to your company or safety program needs.
In-House Designers On Staff
If you are looking for a sign that will really pop, just give us a rough idea of what your sign
should look like and our design team will make it shine.
Hundreds of Signs to Choose From
View our selection of affordable, high quality accident scoreboards or create your own custom
scoreboard using any of our existing designs as a starting point.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Get answers to our most commonly asked questions.

### What is a safety scoreboard?

A safety scoreboard offers businesses the perfect solution to keep track of their workforce's days
without safety-related accidents. These digital counting signs are posted wherever you would like to
promote safe working procedures and are designed to encourage & incentivize employees to beat their
record. Safety scoreboards have been shown to be an effective way to decrease incidents in the
workplace.

### How can I get a custom designed scoreboard?

Each of our signs is built to order in our facility here in the United States and tailored to your
exact needs. You may wish to label each counter with a department or team name, add your facility's
location, insert your company branding or safety program logos and messages. Whatever you can dream
up, we can produce. You'll always have an opportunity to approve your custom design before we
manufacture it. Simply contact us to start your custom design quote.

### What kind of styles & designs do you offer?

Our most common numeric displays are available in 5” and 2.3” height and four digits long, but we
have options to increase digit count up to 16 and digit height up to 12 inches! Our red, yellow, and
green safety stoplights can help to notify your workforce of an incident or near-miss and are
available in 4” and 8” diameters. We also offer several sizes of our new multi-color lights which
can be set to any color you need! Our number displays are quite flexible allowing you to count up or
down each second, minute, hour, day, week, or month and can also be set to just display a static
number. We also offer full color scrolling message displays in a variety of sizes that can display
user configured messages and animated images! When combined these various display options produce
incredible possibilities for communicating your safety message with a single custom sign.

### How much does a custom designed scoreboard cost?

Pricing of your sign depends primarily on the sign size, type and quantity of display components as
well as your desired mounting and control options. We never charge for custom artwork, so you can
change text, add your logo, and move displays for no extra cost. Our web prices are always up to
date and automatically adjust based on the control and mounting options selected.

### How do I place an order?

Orders are taken via this website. We try to make our online ordering and design process as simple
as possible, but if you need any assistance feel free send us an email at support@cousign.com or
give us a call at (269) 290-1222. We do our best to answer all emails promptly. Once we know what
you are looking for, we can send you a customized order link that will make placing your order a
breeze.

## Why Choose Cousign?

Being in the digital sign business for over 15 years means Cousign founders Chris & Steve Trottier
know safety signs. Our goal is to provide simple and effective signage for businesses to improve
safety around the workplace through our cost-effective counting signs that are great for employees
and business owners alike. Here are some of our unique offerings:
Custom Safety Scoreboard Signs
Don't see a scoreboard design that works for you? We provide custom safety scoreboard solutions that
are sure to match your vision & accomplish your goals.
Design Your Sign Online
Our [online design tool][73] allows you to choose a suitable display configuration and customize the
text and graphics to your company or safety program needs.
In-House Designers On Staff
If you are looking for a sign that will really pop, just give us a rough idea of what your sign
should look like and our design team will make it shine.
Hundreds of Signs to Choose From
View our selection of affordable, high quality accident scoreboards or create your own custom
scoreboard using any of our existing designs as a starting point.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Get answers to our most commonly asked questions.

### What is a safety scoreboard?

A safety scoreboard offers businesses the perfect solution to keep track of their workforce's days
without safety-related accidents. These digital counting signs are posted wherever you would like to
promote safe working procedures and are designed to encourage & incentivize employees to beat their
record. Safety scoreboards have been shown to be an effective way to decrease incidents in the
workplace.

### How can I get a custom designed scoreboard?

Each of our signs is built to order in our facility here in the United States and tailored to your
exact needs. You may wish to label each counter with a department or team name, add your facility's
location, insert your company branding or safety program logos and messages. Whatever you can dream
up, we can produce. You'll always have an opportunity to approve your custom design before we
manufacture it. Simply contact us to start your custom design quote.

### What kind of styles & designs do you offer?

Our most common numeric displays are available in 5” and 2.3” height and four digits long, but we
have options to increase digit count up to 16 and digit height up to 12 inches! Our red, yellow, and
green safety stoplights can help to notify your workforce of an incident or near-miss and are
available in 4” and 8” diameters. We also offer several sizes of our new multi-color lights which
can be set to any color you need! Our number displays are quite flexible allowing you to count up or
down each second, minute, hour, day, week, or month and can also be set to just display a static
number. We also offer full color scrolling message displays in a variety of sizes that can display
user configured messages and animated images! When combined these various display options produce
incredible possibilities for communicating your safety message with a single custom sign.

### How much does a custom designed scoreboard cost?

Pricing of your sign depends primarily on the sign size, type and quantity of display components as
well as your desired mounting and control options. We never charge for custom artwork, so you can
change text, add your logo, and move displays for no extra cost. Our web prices are always up to
date and automatically adjust based on the control and mounting options selected.

### How do I place an order?

Orders are taken via this website. We try to make our online ordering and design process as simple
as possible, but if you need any assistance feel free send us an email at support@cousign.com or
give us a call at (269) 290-1222. We do our best to answer all emails promptly. Once we know what
you are looking for, we can send you a customized order link that will make placing your order a
breeze.

[ ## Life Science ## Research ][258] [ Products for life science research, including stimulators, amplifiers, patch-clamp systems, micro-manipulators, incubation chambers, perfusion systems and other equipment for electrophysiology. ][259] [ ## NeuroLog ## System ][260] [ The NeuroLog System is a compact, versatile and modular electrophysiology workstation suitable for roles as diverse as amplification, pulse generation, signal conditioning and stimulation. ][261] [ ## Human ## Neurophysiology ][262] [ Electrical stimulators, EMG/EEG amplifiers and accessories for human research and clinical neurophysiology, including neuromonitoring, neurodiagnostics, sports physiology and basic nerve & muscle research. ][263] [ ## Paediatric ## Surgery ][264] [ Our CE MDD and FDA cleared DS7AP muscle locating stimulator is designed for paediatric surgeons who need a reliable and easy to use electrical stimulator for Peña or PSARP anorectal reconstruction. ][265] [ ## Urodynamics ## & Manometry ][266] [ Digitimer offers a range of clinical urodynamics & manometry products, which includes our own-brand disposables, urethral and rectal catheters, as well as an extensive selection of pessaries and continence aids. ][267] For over 50 years, Digitimer has designed and manufactured quality medical and laboratory scientific instruments, including biological amplifiers for extracellular, intracellular, EEG or EMG electrophysiological recording and electrical stimulators for *in vitro*, animal and human applications, including evoked potential, nerve excitability and intraoperative monitoring.  We have an extensive range of pulse generators and signal conditioners, including those within our modular NeuroLog System. Digitimer also represents several partner companies including Alpha MED Scientific, Automate Scientific, Narishige, Scientific Systems Design. ## Latest Blogs/News [ [D187 D188 and D189 Remote electrode Selectors] ## Product Focus – Remote Electrode Selectors Read More ][268] [ [vDS8R virtual front panel software] ## 10 Reasons to Upgrade to the Digitimer DS8R Research Stimulator Read More ][269] [ ## Temporal Interference Stimulation Suppresses Epileptic Biomarkers Read More ][270] [ ## Core Isolation Compatible Drivers for DS5 and D440 Now Available Read More ][271] [View all][272] ## Life Science Research Digitimer have designed, manufactured and distributed a wide range of quality electrophysiology equipment, including biological amplifiers, stimulators and other products, used by biomedical researchers worldwide. We offer a variety of in vitro and in vivo electrophysiology equipment to complement our own products and currently represent eight respected life science research instrument manufacturers. # Focus To-Do

][4]

## Be focused and make things easier.

Focus To-Do is an easy-to-use time and task management application that helps you to manage tasks
anywhere and anytime, and helps you to perform tasks efficiently. Millions of users around the world
use our application and have gained efficiency.

[Download Focus To-Do][5]

### Based on the Pomodoro Technique

Set an execution time for the task, focus on the task until the end of the time, the harvest is not
only efficiency, but also the unexpected sense of accomplishment.

### Collect and manage anything

You can use it to make plans for work and study, record shopping lists, set up birthday reminders or
arrange your schedule. Focus To-Do can help you get everything done in life and work.

### Historical statistics

Help you analyze the work time and the completion of the tasks, the time spent on work every
day/week/month and the time ratio of your projects. Make time traceable.

### Access from anywhere

Whether you are on a mobile phone, a computer or a tablet, you can record tasks or start a Pomodoro
at anytime or anywhere.

### Features
* Pomodoro Technique
  Let you concentrate on your work, finish your work efficiently, and say goodbye to the
  procrastinates
* Report
  Record every bit of progress every day
* Synchronize within all devices
  Synchronize data between multiple devices
* Due Date
  Set a due date so that no deadline is missed
* Reminders
  Add a reminder to make sure no task is forgotten
* Subtask
  Split a task into small pieces.
* Repeat
  Frequent tasks no longer need to be added each time
* Note
  Add a note to make sure all information of the task is not missed

## The Complete Countdown Timer Guide for Real Life

Learn how to use a countdown and a countdown timer to plan better, build momentum, and hit important
dates without stress.

A great **countdown** does more than show numbers. It turns vague intentions into visible progress.
When you can see days, hours, minutes, and seconds moving, your brain shifts from “someday” to
“right now.” That is why a reliable **countdown timer** is useful for both big celebrations and
small daily goals. You can track days until Christmas, measure time before a presentation, or run a
focused work block before a meeting. One clear display creates urgency, structure, and calm. Instead
of guessing how much time remains, you get exact information and can act with confidence.

## Why Countdown Pages Keep People Engaged

A live **countdown timer** keeps attention because it updates in real time. Each second confirms
that progress is happening, and that visual feedback makes people stay connected. For families, a
holiday countdown becomes a shared ritual. For teams, a project countdown clarifies priorities. For
students, a study countdown creates a clear finish line. In every case, the countdown changes
behavior because it is visible, simple, and immediate.

The best part is flexibility. A single **countdown** workflow can support birthdays, vacations,
launches, and daily routines without new tools. Set the target, choose a theme, and start. That
consistency is why many users prefer one trusted **countdown timer** instead of switching between
apps. You spend less time configuring and more time executing.

## How to Use This Free Countdown Timer Effectively

If you are new, start with one event that matters this week. Enter the target time, press start, and
let the countdown run where you can see it. If the event is public, use fullscreen mode so everyone
can read the timer from across the room. If the event is personal, keep a compact countdown on your
laptop and check it throughout the day. The right setup depends on audience and distance.

For repeat usage, save a simple pattern: pick the same theme, keep the same audio setting, and run
the same pre-event checklist. That turns your **countdown timer** into a habit system. The easier
your workflow, the more often you will use the countdown and the less likely you are to miss an
important milestone.
* Choose one target date and one clear goal for the countdown.
* Use fullscreen countdown mode for rooms, classrooms, and meetings.
* Enable reminders when your countdown timer reaches key checkpoints.
* Reuse the same setup so every new countdown starts in seconds.

## Best Events to Track with a Countdown Timer

Popular use cases are easy to understand: a holiday **countdown** builds anticipation, a birthday
countdown adds excitement, and a vacation countdown keeps planning on schedule. But practical use
cases are just as valuable. You can run a countdown timer for onboarding deadlines, weekly reviews,
speaking practice, exam prep, fitness circuits, and launch windows. The format is the same; only the
target changes.

## Fullscreen Countdown Tips for Big Screens

A fullscreen **countdown timer** works best when contrast is strong and layout is minimal. On TV or
projector screens, extra UI elements can reduce readability, so keep the focus on large digits and
short labels. This is especially helpful for school activities, wedding timelines, party entrances,
and conference segments where people view the countdown from different distances.

Test your countdown before the event starts. Check brightness, color contrast, and how the timer
looks from the back of the room. If the event is long, keep your device plugged in and your browser
tab active. A smooth countdown experience feels professional and helps your audience trust the
schedule.

## Build Better Routines with a Daily Countdown

You do not need a major holiday to benefit from a **countdown**. Many people run daily countdown
blocks for focused work, reading, workouts, and study sessions. Start a 25-minute countdown timer,

reduces procrastination because the finish line is always visible.

This approach also helps teams. A shared countdown during stand-ups, planning meetings, or sprint
reviews protects everyone’s time. Instead of drifting into long discussions, the countdown keeps
communication concise and outcome-driven. Over weeks, that small structure leads to better execution

## The Complete Countdown Timer Guide for Real Life

Learn how to use a countdown and a countdown timer to plan better, build momentum, and hit important
dates without stress.

A great **countdown** does more than show numbers. It turns vague intentions into visible progress.
When you can see days, hours, minutes, and seconds moving, your brain shifts from “someday” to
“right now.” That is why a reliable **countdown timer** is useful for both big celebrations and
small daily goals. You can track days until Christmas, measure time before a presentation, or run a
focused work block before a meeting. One clear display creates urgency, structure, and calm. Instead
of guessing how much time remains, you get exact information and can act with confidence.

## Why Countdown Pages Keep People Engaged

A live **countdown timer** keeps attention because it updates in real time. Each second confirms
that progress is happening, and that visual feedback makes people stay connected. For families, a
holiday countdown becomes a shared ritual. For teams, a project countdown clarifies priorities. For
students, a study countdown creates a clear finish line. In every case, the countdown changes
behavior because it is visible, simple, and immediate.

The best part is flexibility. A single **countdown** workflow can support birthdays, vacations,
launches, and daily routines without new tools. Set the target, choose a theme, and start. That
consistency is why many users prefer one trusted **countdown timer** instead of switching between
apps. You spend less time configuring and more time executing.

## How to Use This Free Countdown Timer Effectively

If you are new, start with one event that matters this week. Enter the target time, press start, and
let the countdown run where you can see it. If the event is public, use fullscreen mode so everyone
can read the timer from across the room. If the event is personal, keep a compact countdown on your
laptop and check it throughout the day. The right setup depends on audience and distance.

For repeat usage, save a simple pattern: pick the same theme, keep the same audio setting, and run
the same pre-event checklist. That turns your **countdown timer** into a habit system. The easier
your workflow, the more often you will use the countdown and the less likely you are to miss an
important milestone.
* Choose one target date and one clear goal for the countdown.
* Use fullscreen countdown mode for rooms, classrooms, and meetings.
* Enable reminders when your countdown timer reaches key checkpoints.
* Reuse the same setup so every new countdown starts in seconds.

## Best Events to Track with a Countdown Timer

Popular use cases are easy to understand: a holiday **countdown** builds anticipation, a birthday
countdown adds excitement, and a vacation countdown keeps planning on schedule. But practical use
cases are just as valuable. You can run a countdown timer for onboarding deadlines, weekly reviews,
speaking practice, exam prep, fitness circuits, and launch windows. The format is the same; only the
target changes.

## Fullscreen Countdown Tips for Big Screens

A fullscreen **countdown timer** works best when contrast is strong and layout is minimal. On TV or
projector screens, extra UI elements can reduce readability, so keep the focus on large digits and
short labels. This is especially helpful for school activities, wedding timelines, party entrances,
and conference segments where people view the countdown from different distances.

Test your countdown before the event starts. Check brightness, color contrast, and how the timer
looks from the back of the room. If the event is long, keep your device plugged in and your browser
tab active. A smooth countdown experience feels professional and helps your audience trust the
schedule.

## Build Better Routines with a Daily Countdown

You do not need a major holiday to benefit from a **countdown**. Many people run daily countdown
blocks for focused work, reading, workouts, and study sessions. Start a 25-minute countdown timer,
work without interruptions, then take a short break. Repeating this cycle creates momentum and
reduces procrastination because the finish line is always visible.

This approach also helps teams. A shared countdown during stand-ups, planning meetings, or sprint
reviews protects everyone’s time. Instead of drifting into long discussions, the countdown keeps
communication concise and outcome-driven. Over weeks, that small structure leads to better execution
and less meeting fatigue.

## What is GClocks?

**GClocks** is your all-in-one online timekeeping toolkit, designed for simplicity, speed, and
precision. Whether you're a student trying to manage your study time, a remote worker across time
zones, or just someone who needs a quick countdown for cooking or meditation, GClocks is the perfect
solution.

Unlike traditional apps that require downloads or logins, GClocks works instantly in your web
browser. You get fast-loading, minimal, and distraction-free tools that help you focus on what
really matters — your time.

Our suite of tools includes:
* **Online Clock** – A fullscreen, distraction-free clock to stay aware of the current time.
* **Timer** – Count down for any task with sound alerts and customizable settings.
* **Alarm** – Set alarms in your browser with no need for apps or notifications access.
* **Stopwatch** – Track elapsed time with lap functionality and exportable data.
* **World Clock** – See multiple time zones at once. Ideal for international teams or travel
  planning.
* **Calendar** – Simple, elegant, and fast calendar view to check dates at a glance.

GClocks is designed with user experience in mind: it’s fast, lightweight, mobile-responsive, and
completely free. You won’t find unnecessary pop-ups, heavy graphics, or confusing menus — just the
tools you need, right when you need them.

Whether you're working from a laptop, tablet, or mobile phone, GClocks adapts to your screen and
works reliably across all modern browsers.

At GClocks, we believe time is your most valuable resource. Our mission is to help you make the most
of it — through clean, powerful tools that just work.

Try it now. No sign-up. No setup. Just time, redefined.

## Why choose GClocks?

### Instant Access

Use all tools instantly in your browser—no download, no installation required.

### Global Accuracy

Synced with world time servers for reliable and precise timekeeping.

### Mobile-Friendly

Responsive design optimized for smartphones, tablets, and desktops.

### Privacy First

No tracking, no ads, no signups — your time and data stay private.

## Frequently asked questions about GClocks

1. What is GClocks?
➥ GClocks is an online platform offering a suite of time-related tools such as clocks, alarms,
timers, calendars, and more—all in one place.
2. Why should I use GClocks instead of installing apps?
➥ GClocks runs directly in your browser with no downloads or installations. It's fast, lightweight,
and accessible on any device.
3. Is GClocks completely free?
➥ Yes. All features on GClocks are 100% free to use, with no hidden charges or subscriptions.
4. Do I need to create an account to use GClocks?
➥ No, GClocks does not require user registration. You can start using any tool instantly.
5. What kind of tools does GClocks provide?
➥ GClocks provides online tools such as alarm clocks, countdown timers, world clocks, calendars, and
more for everyday use.
6. Is GClocks mobile-friendly?
➥ Absolutely. GClocks is designed to work smoothly on smartphones, tablets, and desktops.
7. Does GClocks support multiple languages?
➥ Yes, GClocks supports over 30 languages to make it accessible to users worldwide.
8. Can I trust GClocks with my data?
➥ Yes. GClocks does not collect personal data, and tools work locally in your browser to ensure
privacy.
9. Do GClocks tools work offline?
➥ Some tools may work offline once loaded, but for best results and features, an internet connection
is recommended.
10. How is GClocks different from other online time tools?
➥ GClocks offers a clean interface, multi-tool integration, responsive design, and multilingual
support—all in one platform.
11. Do the tools have sound alerts?
➥ Yes, many GClocks tools come with customizable sound alerts to enhance usability.
12. Is my time zone automatically detected?
➥ Yes, GClocks automatically detects your time zone and adjusts accordingly.
13. Can I use GClocks for productivity and time management?
➥ Definitely. GClocks is ideal for time tracking, reminders, countdowns, and scheduling.
14. What devices are compatible with GClocks?
➥ GClocks works seamlessly on all modern devices and browsers, including Windows, macOS, iOS,
Android, Chrome, Firefox, and Safari.
15. How often is GClocks updated?
➥ GClocks is regularly updated with new tools, features, and design improvements to enhance user
experience.

## What is GClocks?

**GClocks** is your all-in-one online timekeeping toolkit, designed for simplicity, speed, and
precision. Whether you're a student trying to manage your study time, a remote worker across time
zones, or just someone who needs a quick countdown for cooking or meditation, GClocks is the perfect
solution.

Unlike traditional apps that require downloads or logins, GClocks works instantly in your web
browser. You get fast-loading, minimal, and distraction-free tools that help you focus on what
really matters — your time.

Our suite of tools includes:
* **Online Clock** – A fullscreen, distraction-free clock to stay aware of the current time.
* **Timer** – Count down for any task with sound alerts and customizable settings.
* **Alarm** – Set alarms in your browser with no need for apps or notifications access.
* **Stopwatch** – Track elapsed time with lap functionality and exportable data.
* **World Clock** – See multiple time zones at once. Ideal for international teams or travel
  planning.
* **Calendar** – Simple, elegant, and fast calendar view to check dates at a glance.

GClocks is designed with user experience in mind: it’s fast, lightweight, mobile-responsive, and
completely free. You won’t find unnecessary pop-ups, heavy graphics, or confusing menus — just the
tools you need, right when you need them.

Whether you're working from a laptop, tablet, or mobile phone, GClocks adapts to your screen and
works reliably across all modern browsers.

At GClocks, we believe time is your most valuable resource. Our mission is to help you make the most
of it — through clean, powerful tools that just work.

Try it now. No sign-up. No setup. Just time, redefined.

## Trusted Hydroponics Store for Every Grower

GrowersHouse is your trusted source for professional-grade grow equipment backed by expert support
and fast fulfillment. Whether you’re a professional optimizing a hydroponic system or a hobbyist
getting started with your hydroponic garden, we have the products, kits, and accessories to help you
grow better with less guesswork....

## Large Selection for Your Hydroponic System

We offer complete solutions for indoor cultivation at any scale. From grow tents and lighting
systems to carbon filters and nutrient solutions, we have everything you need for a functional and
efficient hydroponic setup.

Browse top-rated brands used by commercial cultivators, serious home growers, and beginners, such as
AC Infinity, HLG, Gavita, and Growers Choice. Whether you need a complete grow tent kit or inert
hydroponic growing media, you will get products only from the most established sources.

## Expert Support for Growing Plants

GrowersHouse is here to help you build a clean, productive grow space from the ground up, whether
you’re setting up your first 2'x2' tent or upgrading to a fully controlled WiFi-integrated grow
environment. If you have any concerns, contact our expert customer service team for assistance.

We have commercial account executives for your complex business needs, world-class professionals
with PhDs for horticulture consulting, and other experts who can help you every step of the way.

Get real product guidance, custom recommendations, and support from people with real knowledge and
industry experience.

## Quick Product Fulfillment

Fast, reliable fulfillment is one of the biggest reasons growers of all sizes count on us. We offer
free shipping on orders across the continental U.S., so you can equip your hydroponic systems
without worrying about hidden fees or freight costs.

If you need your hydroponic supplies right away, we have a Will Call pickup service at our Tucson
and Phoenix locations. Most in-stock items are ready for pickup within an hour of placing your
order, so you can keep your grow operation on schedule.

## Take Your Grow Room to New Heights

## Trusted Hydroponics Store for Every Grower

GrowersHouse is your trusted source for professional-grade grow equipment backed by expert support
and fast fulfillment. Whether you’re a professional optimizing a hydroponic system or a hobbyist
getting started with your hydroponic garden, we have the products, kits, and accessories to help you
grow better with less guesswork....

## Large Selection for Your Hydroponic System

We offer complete solutions for indoor cultivation at any scale. From grow tents and lighting
systems to carbon filters and nutrient solutions, we have everything you need for a functional and
efficient hydroponic setup.

Browse top-rated brands used by commercial cultivators, serious home growers, and beginners, such as
AC Infinity, HLG, Gavita, and Growers Choice. Whether you need a complete grow tent kit or inert
hydroponic growing media, you will get products only from the most established sources.

## Expert Support for Growing Plants

GrowersHouse is here to help you build a clean, productive grow space from the ground up, whether
you’re setting up your first 2'x2' tent or upgrading to a fully controlled WiFi-integrated grow
environment. If you have any concerns, contact our expert customer service team for assistance.

We have commercial account executives for your complex business needs, world-class professionals
with PhDs for horticulture consulting, and other experts who can help you every step of the way.

Get real product guidance, custom recommendations, and support from people with real knowledge and
industry experience.

## Quick Product Fulfillment

Fast, reliable fulfillment is one of the biggest reasons growers of all sizes count on us. We offer
free shipping on orders across the continental U.S., so you can equip your hydroponic systems
without worrying about hidden fees or freight costs.

If you need your hydroponic supplies right away, we have a Will Call pickup service at our Tucson
and Phoenix locations. Most in-stock items are ready for pickup within an hour of placing your
order, so you can keep your grow operation on schedule.

## Take Your Grow Room to New Heights

From leafy vegetables and fragrant herbs to vibrant flowers, every indoor garden starts with the
right setup. Whether you grow in soil or hydroponic media, we provide complete systems, individual
products, and accessories built for healthier plants and stronger yields.

With expert support and reliable shipping and pickup, everything you need is right here at

## Full Custom & Standard Integrated Circuits

#### As a fabless semiconductor company, we are in full control of **design, development, and
#### testing**

### Standard ICs

Our wide selection of **standard products** are trusted in several high volume and niche industries
and come with the same high level of technical support provided for our Full Custom ICs.

### Custom ASICs

LSI/CSI offers turnkey development of **mixed signal, full custom ICs**. An LSI/CSI full custom
design results in the highest performance custom chip at the lowest possible price for a high volume
application.

## New Products

#### Check out our latest ICs

## LS7466

### 24-BIT 2-Axes Programmable Quadrature Counter with Serial (SPI) Interface (16-Pins)

Incremental Encoder Interface, Counters

LS7466 is a monolithic CMOS 24-bit programmable counter. It consists of two identical functional
modules to interface with X and Y axes encoders simultaneously. Each block consists of the following
registers: MCR0, MCR1, IDR, ODR, CNTR, DSTR and SSTR. MCR0 and MCR1 controls the functional modes.

[ View Product ][45]

## LS7866

### 32-Bit Quadrature Counter w/ I2C Interface (14-Pins)

Incremental Encoder Interface, Counters

LS7866 is a monolithic CMOS 32-bit counter, programmable to operate in 8-bit, 16-bit, 24-bit or
32-bit modular structures. Inputs are provided to interface directly with the quadrature clocks and
the index markers from incremental encoders.

[ View Product ][46]

## LS7641

### Reverse Phase (Trailing-Edge) Light Dimmer For LED Lamps (14-Pins)

LED Drivers, Lighting Controls

LS7641 is a monolithic CMOS lamp dimmer IC designed for in line wall switch applications driving
both LED and incandescent lamps. It uses Reverse Phase dimming technology wherein the brightness of
a lamp is controlled by controlling the turn-off angle in ac half cycles using a FET.

[ View Product ][47]

## LS9200

### Dimmable LED Driver (8 Pins)

LED Drivers

LS9200 is a monolithic CMOS device for driving and dimming LED networks. The regulated constant
current is maintained with an external sense resistor forming part of a feedback loop. The maximum
LED load current is set by the sense resistor whose duty cycle can be modulated with a built in PWM
circuit.

[ View Product ][48]

## LS7190; LS7191; LS7192

### Digital Potentiometers (14 Pins)

3-terminal digital potentiometer with two fixed terminals and a variable wiper terminal with 64 tap
positions

The wiper tap position can be varied with any of the following available input signals: up/down
clock or A/B quadrature clock **or direct data transfer over SPI bus**.

[ View Product ][49]

## LS7193; LS7194

### Digital Potentiometers (8 Pins)

3-terminal digital potentiometer with two fixed terminals and a variable wiper terminal with 64 tap
positions

The wiper tap position can be varied with one of the following input signals: up/down clock or A/B
quadrature clock.

## LS7466

### 24-BIT 2-Axes Programmable Quadrature Counter with Serial (SPI) Interface (16-Pins)

Incremental Encoder Interface, Counters

LS7466 is a monolithic CMOS 24-bit programmable counter. It consists of two identical functional
modules to interface with X and Y axes encoders simultaneously. Each block consists of the following
registers: MCR0, MCR1, IDR, ODR, CNTR, DSTR and SSTR. MCR0 and MCR1 controls the functional modes.

[ View Product ][45]

## LS7866

### 32-Bit Quadrature Counter w/ I2C Interface (14-Pins)

Incremental Encoder Interface, Counters

LS7866 is a monolithic CMOS 32-bit counter, programmable to operate in 8-bit, 16-bit, 24-bit or
32-bit modular structures. Inputs are provided to interface directly with the quadrature clocks and
the index markers from incremental encoders.

[ View Product ][46]

## LS7641

### Reverse Phase (Trailing-Edge) Light Dimmer For LED Lamps (14-Pins)

LED Drivers, Lighting Controls

LS7641 is a monolithic CMOS lamp dimmer IC designed for in line wall switch applications driving
both LED and incandescent lamps. It uses Reverse Phase dimming technology wherein the brightness of
a lamp is controlled by controlling the turn-off angle in ac half cycles using a FET.

[ View Product ][47]

## LS9200

### Dimmable LED Driver (8 Pins)

LED Drivers

LS9200 is a monolithic CMOS device for driving and dimming LED networks. The regulated constant
current is maintained with an external sense resistor forming part of a feedback loop. The maximum
LED load current is set by the sense resistor whose duty cycle can be modulated with a built in PWM
circuit.

[ View Product ][48]

## LS7190; LS7191; LS7192

### Digital Potentiometers (14 Pins)

3-terminal digital potentiometer with two fixed terminals and a variable wiper terminal with 64 tap
positions

The wiper tap position can be varied with any of the following available input signals: up/down
clock or A/B quadrature clock **or direct data transfer over SPI bus**.

[ View Product ][49]

Technologies, Material Handling, Air Handling and Storage Systems for over five decades. Since its
inception in 1973, Statfield India Pvt. Ltd. has remained on the forefront in surface coating
technology in India and overseas.

turnkey surface coating plants. With a strong focus on innovation and industry-leading technology,
we have introduced cutting-edge solutions that set new benchmarks in the field. Exporting to over 45
countries worldwide, Intech is widely recognized for delivering high-quality, customized coating
solutions tailored to meet the unique requirements of our customers.

## Online Alarm Kur Nedir?

Online Alarm Kur, zamanında uyanmanıza ve gün boyu yerine getireceğiniz görevler için hatırlatıcılar
ayarlamanıza yardımcı olmak için tasarlanmış bir online araçtır.

Aracı kullanmak oldukça basittir; alarm kurmak istediğiniz saati ve alarm sesini seçin, alarmınıza
isim verin ve kaydedin. Sonrasında tek yapmanız gereken alarmın çalışması için tarayıcı sekmesini
açık tutmak. Böylece alarm sizi ayarladığınız saatte sesli bir şekilde uyaracaktır.

Belirli bir saat yerine süreyi ayarlamak için sitede yer alan [online zamanlayıcı][12] aracını
kullanabilirsiniz.

## Online Alarm Nasıl Kurulur?

Aracın kullanımı son derece kolay ve tamamen ücretsizdir. Aşağıda yer alan basit adımları takip
etmeniz yeterli olacaktır:
1. Alarm kurmadan önce ekranın üst kısmında yer alan [dijital saat][13] aracılığıyla geçerli saati
   kontrol edin.
2. **Alarm saatini ayarla** kısmından alarm kurmak istediğiniz zamanı Saat ve Dakika cinsinden seçin
   veya önceden seçilmiş alarm saatlerinden dilediğinizi işaretleyin.
3. Listede yer alanlar arasında tercih ettiğiniz bir **Alarm sesi** seçin.
4. Dilerseniz, **Alarm başlığı** kısmından alarmınıza bir isim verin.
5. Son olarak alarm kurmak için **Alarm Kur** butonuna tıklayın. Kurduğunuz saat geldiğinde
   alarmınız otomatik olarak çalacaktır.

Birden fazla alarm kurmak için yeni sekme açabilir ve yukarıda yer alan adımları dilediğiniz kadar
tekrarlayabilirsiniz. Alarm kurduktan sonra, ekranda otomatik olarak bir [geri sayım][14]
belirecektir. Bu sayaç, alarmınıza ne kadar süre kaldığını ve tam alarm saatini (alarmın çalacağı
saati) gösterir. Geri sayım sırasında yapabilecekleriniz aşağıdaki gibidir:
* Geri sayımı tam ekran olarak görüntülemek için ekranın sağ üst köşesinde yer alan tam ekran
  simgesine tıklayabilirsiniz.
* Dikkatiniz dağılmadan ekranınızı açık tutmaya yarayacak tamamen karanlık bir ekran için ampul
  simgesine tıklayabilirsiniz.
* Alarmı çalmadan önce iptal etmek için "Durdur" butonuna tıklayabilirsiniz.

Geri sayım sıfıra ulaştığında ve alarm çaldığında ekranda iki seçenek belirecektir:
* Alarmı sonlandırmak için **Durdur** butonuna tıklayın.
* 10 dakika ertelemek için **Ertele** butonuna tıklayın.

### Alarm ayarları

Alarmınızı özelleştirmek için ekranın sağ üst köşesinde yer alan "Ayarlar" simgesine tıklayın.
Burada aşağıdaki işlemleri yapabilirsiniz:
* Alarm sesinin şiddetini ayarlayabilirsiniz.
* Varsayılan erteleme süresini değiştirebilirsiniz.
* Tekrarlayan alarm sesini etkinleştirebilir veya devre dışı bırakabilirsiniz.
* Alarm saatini (alarmın ne zaman çalacağını) gösterebilir veya gizleyebilirsiniz.
* İlerleme çubuğunu gösterebilir veya gizleyebilirsiniz.

## Sıkça Sorulan Sorular

### Alarm sesi yüksek mi?

Evet, alarm sesi yüksek olabilir. En üst sağda yer alan ayarlar ikonuna tıklayarak alarm sesinin
şiddetini ayarlayabilirsiniz.

### İnternet bağlantısına ihtiyacım var mı?

Sayfayı yüklemek ve alarm kurmak için internet bağlantısı gerekir. Ancak bir kez alarm kurulduktan
sonra internet bağlantısı kesilse bile saati geldiğinde alarm çalacaktır.

### Sekmeyi kapatırsam alarm çalışır mı?

Hayır, sekmeyi kapatırsanız alarm çalışmaz. Ancak, alarmın çalması için tarayıcı sekmesinin etkin
olması gerekmez, diğer sekmelerde istediğinizi yapabilirsiniz.

### Bilgisayar uyku modundayken alarm çalışır mı?

Hayır, bilgisayar uyku modundaysa alarm çalışmaz. Ancak, yalnızca ekranınız kapalıyken alarm
çalışmaya devam edecektir.

Sisteminizin ekran kapalıyken alarmı etkin tutup tutmadığından emin değilseniz, önceden test edin
veya güvenlik için ekranınızı açık tutun. Dizüstü bilgisayarınızın kapağını kapatırsanız da aracın
çalışmayacağını lütfen unutmayın.

## Türkiye'nin Uyku Alışkanlıkları

Kullanıcılarımıza yönelik iki ayrı anonim ankette Türkiye'nin uyku rutinini inceledik. İlkinde yatış
ve uyanış saatlerini, ikincisinde ise uyku sürelerini ve hangi şehirde yaşadıklarını sorduk. Her iki
ankete de binden fazla kişi katıldı.

## Online Alarm Kur Nedir?

Online Alarm Kur, zamanında uyanmanıza ve gün boyu yerine getireceğiniz görevler için hatırlatıcılar
ayarlamanıza yardımcı olmak için tasarlanmış bir online araçtır.

Aracı kullanmak oldukça basittir; alarm kurmak istediğiniz saati ve alarm sesini seçin, alarmınıza
isim verin ve kaydedin. Sonrasında tek yapmanız gereken alarmın çalışması için tarayıcı sekmesini
açık tutmak. Böylece alarm sizi ayarladığınız saatte sesli bir şekilde uyaracaktır.

Belirli bir saat yerine süreyi ayarlamak için sitede yer alan [online zamanlayıcı][12] aracını
kullanabilirsiniz.

## Online Alarm Nasıl Kurulur?

Aracın kullanımı son derece kolay ve tamamen ücretsizdir. Aşağıda yer alan basit adımları takip
etmeniz yeterli olacaktır:
1. Alarm kurmadan önce ekranın üst kısmında yer alan [dijital saat][13] aracılığıyla geçerli saati
   kontrol edin.
2. **Alarm saatini ayarla** kısmından alarm kurmak istediğiniz zamanı Saat ve Dakika cinsinden seçin
   veya önceden seçilmiş alarm saatlerinden dilediğinizi işaretleyin.
3. Listede yer alanlar arasında tercih ettiğiniz bir **Alarm sesi** seçin.
4. Dilerseniz, **Alarm başlığı** kısmından alarmınıza bir isim verin.
5. Son olarak alarm kurmak için **Alarm Kur** butonuna tıklayın. Kurduğunuz saat geldiğinde
   alarmınız otomatik olarak çalacaktır.

Birden fazla alarm kurmak için yeni sekme açabilir ve yukarıda yer alan adımları dilediğiniz kadar
tekrarlayabilirsiniz. Alarm kurduktan sonra, ekranda otomatik olarak bir [geri sayım][14]
belirecektir. Bu sayaç, alarmınıza ne kadar süre kaldığını ve tam alarm saatini (alarmın çalacağı
saati) gösterir. Geri sayım sırasında yapabilecekleriniz aşağıdaki gibidir:
* Geri sayımı tam ekran olarak görüntülemek için ekranın sağ üst köşesinde yer alan tam ekran
  simgesine tıklayabilirsiniz.
* Dikkatiniz dağılmadan ekranınızı açık tutmaya yarayacak tamamen karanlık bir ekran için ampul
  simgesine tıklayabilirsiniz.
* Alarmı çalmadan önce iptal etmek için "Durdur" butonuna tıklayabilirsiniz.

Geri sayım sıfıra ulaştığında ve alarm çaldığında ekranda iki seçenek belirecektir:
* Alarmı sonlandırmak için **Durdur** butonuna tıklayın.
* 10 dakika ertelemek için **Ertele** butonuna tıklayın.

### Alarm ayarları

Alarmınızı özelleştirmek için ekranın sağ üst köşesinde yer alan "Ayarlar" simgesine tıklayın.
Burada aşağıdaki işlemleri yapabilirsiniz:
* Alarm sesinin şiddetini ayarlayabilirsiniz.
* Varsayılan erteleme süresini değiştirebilirsiniz.
* Tekrarlayan alarm sesini etkinleştirebilir veya devre dışı bırakabilirsiniz.
* Alarm saatini (alarmın ne zaman çalacağını) gösterebilir veya gizleyebilirsiniz.
* İlerleme çubuğunu gösterebilir veya gizleyebilirsiniz.

Evet, alarm sesi yüksek olabilir. En üst sağda yer alan ayarlar ikonuna tıklayarak alarm sesinin
şiddetini ayarlayabilirsiniz.

A complete productivity system — not just a timer. Created by Francesco Cirillo.

The timer is only the starting point. The full Pomodoro® Technique includes **daily planning,
interruption management, and effort estimation** — a complete system for making deep work
sustainable. Start with the free resources below, or learn the complete method in the official
self-paced program.

[View the Program][9] [Download Free Sheets][10]

20 weeks. Entirely online. From the creator of the technique.

$49 / 5 months access

Completion.

Founding price. Future: $149

#### Certified Practitioner

$149 / 5 months access

Everything in the Practitioner Program plus 3 evaluated assignments, written feedback from
Francesco, and official Certified Practitioner credential.

Founding price. Future: $499

Everything you need for your first Pomodoro® session. Download the sheets, pick a timer, and begin.

immediately.

**Plan your daily Pomodoros**
Select tasks from your Activity Inventory and commit to what you'll accomplish today. Track
completed Pomodoros and handle interruptions.

[ Download Sheet ][13]

#### Pomodoro® Activity Inventory eSheet - FREE

**Capture and organize all your tasks**
The foundation of the Pomodoro® Technique. List everything you need to do, estimate effort, and
prioritize effectively.

[ Download Sheet ][14]

#### Pomodoro® Records eSheet - FREE

**Track progress and improve your process**
Record completed Pomodoros to understand how long tasks really take. Essential for improving your
planning accuracy over time.

[ Download Sheet ][15]

Three official timers, all free. Browser needs no installation. Desktop integrates with Windows. PWA

# An online Pomodoro Timer to boost your productivity

## What is Pomofocus?

Pomofocus is a customizable pomodoro timer that works on desktop & mobile browser. The aim of this
app is to help you focus on any task you are working on, such as study, writing, or coding. This app
is inspired by [Pomodoro Technique][1] which is a time management method developed by Francesco
Cirillo.

## What is Pomodoro Technique?

The Pomodoro Technique is created by Francesco Cirillo for a more productive way to work and study.
The technique uses a timer to break down work into intervals, traditionally 25 minutes in length,
separated by short breaks. Each interval is known as a pomodoro, from the Italian word for 'tomato',
after the tomato-shaped kitchen timer that Cirillo used as a university student. - [Wikipedia][2]

## How to use the Pomodoro Timer?
1. **Add tasks** to work on today
2. **Set estimate pomodoros** (1 = 25min of work) for each tasks
3. **Select a task** to work on
4. **Start timer** and focus on the task for 25 minutes
5. **Take a break** for 5 minutes when the alarm ring
6. **Iterate** 3-5 until you finish the tasks

## Basic Features
* **Estimate Finish Time:** Get an estimate of the time required to complete your daily tasks.
* **Add Templates:** Save your repetitive tasks as templates and add them with just one click.
* **Visual Reports:** See how much time you've focused each day, week, and month.
* **Custom Settings:** Personalize your focus/break time, alarm sounds, background sounds, and more.

## Premium Features
* **Add Projects:** Track how much time you spend on each project.
* **Yearly Reports:** View your focus hours for each year.
* **Download Reports:** Download your focus history in CSV format.
* **No Template Limit:** Save more than 3 templates.
* **Todoist Integration:** Load tasks from your Todoist account.
* **Webhook Integration:** Connect to other apps (Zapier, IFTTT, etc).
* **No Ads:** Enjoy a clean and distraction-free app experience.

## About Us

Ronak Switchgear & Automation – A Ketan Dodia Venture, is a complete solution provider in the world
of Innovation & Automation. Mr. Ketan Chimanlal Dodia is a qualified engineer with his vast
experience of more than 25 years in the field of Industrial Automation & Switchgear Products. He has
started Ronak Switchgear & Automation with a strong vision and aim to provide the best automation
products and solutions.

We cater to the wholesale & distribution segment of the Automation Industry with an extensive array
of Industrial Switchgear & Automation products like Micro Switches, PLC Systems, Electric Relays,
Power Contactors, Proximity Sensors, Capacitors, Limit Switches, Temperature Controllers, etc.

## A versatile platform — handy for professionals of any field and caliber

### Sales managers

Our free CRM system can be the hub of your business, allowing you to manage your sales and
communication channels. Move leads down your sales pipeline automatically, manage deals, and
instantly get all the customer data you need.
[eLearning businesses]

### eLearning businesses

Develop and sell your courses or promote experts' personal brands. With SendPulse, you can teach,
market, and sell on a single platform.
[Industry experts and business owners]

### Industry experts and business owners

Put your brand on the map without hiring any outside professionals. Leverage our drag and drop
editors and pre-made templates to complete your marketing tasks faster.
[Marketers]

### Marketers

Conduct all of your marketing initiatives on a single platform and manage your communication with
customers across multiple channels, increasing your conversion rates and ROI. No integrations
required — the tools are already connected to one another.

Automatically send personalized offers just in time via a customer's preferred communication
channel;


Use chatbots or a live chat to stay in touch with your clients without having to switch between
different tools or accounts;


Monitor your deal and communication history to create personalized sales pipelines and drive
conversion rates.

### General

5 questions in this topic

What is ShareMyTimer?

ShareMyTimer is a shared timer platform that lets one person control a timer while everyone else
sees the same timer synchronized in real time.

How is ShareMyTimer different from a regular online timer?

Regular timers only work on your device. ShareMyTimer shares one countdown with viewers via link or
QR code — start, pause, reset, live messages, and audio alerts all sync to every screen instantly.

Do viewers need an account to join?

No. Viewers can join using a shared link, QR code, or join code without creating an account.

Can I use ShareMyTimer for free?

Yes. ShareMyTimer offers a free plan for getting started. Paid plans unlock additional features and
higher usage limits.

Does ShareMyTimer work on mobile devices?

Yes. ShareMyTimer works on phones, tablets, laptops, and desktop computers through a web browser.

TheKronometre.com, zamanı saat, dakika, saniye ve milisaniye cinsinden ölçen ücretsiz bir online
kronometredir. Bu kronometre 6 temel işlev sunar: başlatma, durdurma, tur kaydı, sıfırlama, tam
ekran modu ve CSV veri dışa aktarma. Spor, eğitim, yemek pişirme, verimlilik ve bilimsel araştırma
alanlarındaki profesyoneller, hassas zamanlama için TheKronometre'yi doğrudan tarayıcıda kullanır —
Android, iOS, Windows ve macOS üzerinde — kurulum gerektirmez.

## Kronometre Nasıl Çalışır?

**Kronometre (chronometer), geçen süreyi yüksek doğrulukla ölçen bir hassas zamanlama aracıdır.**
Uluslararası Ağırlıklar ve Ölçüler Bürosu (BIPM), kronometreleri 4 ana alanda kullanılan hassas
zamanlama cihazları olarak sınıflandırır: atletizm, bilimsel araştırma, endüstriyel üretim ve
eğitim.

Standart bir kronometre 3 temel bileşenden oluşur: bir başlat/durdur mekanizması (düğme), bir zaman
göstergesi ve bir sıfırlama işlevi. Modern dijital kronometre cihazları, bölüm süresi (split time)
takibiyle tur kaydı, milisaniye ölçümü ve CSV veri dışa aktarma özelliklerini de içerir.

Kronometre çeşitleri (mekanik, dijital, online), tarihçesi, salise kavramı ve kronometre ile
zamanlayıcı arasındaki fark gibi konuların ayrıntılı açıklaması için [Kronometre Nedir?][7]
rehberimizi inceleyebilirsiniz.

[ Bir kronometrenin üç fonksiyonunu, üç türünü ve gerçekte nasıl çalıştığını keşfedin ][8]

## Online Kronometre Nedir?

**Online kronometre, herhangi bir bilgisayar, tablet veya akıllı telefonda uygulama indirmeden
çalışan tarayıcı tabanlı bir dijital kronometredir.** Online kronometre araçları, tarayıcı
penceresinde doğrudan milisaniye hassasiyeti sunmak için cihazın yüksek çözünürlüklü performans
zamanlayıcısını kullanır.

TheKronometre.com, telefon tabanlı kronometre uygulamalarına göre 6 avantaj sunar: sıfır kurulum,
depolama alanı kullanmama, otomatik güncellemeler, Android, iOS, Windows ve macOS genelinde çapraz
platform uyumluluğu, klavye kısayolu desteği ve tam masaüstü ekran kullanımı. Online kronometre
Chrome, Safari, Firefox ve Edge'de çalışır.

## Kronometre Geçmişi

1821

### Nicolas Mathieu Rieussec

Fransız saatçi Nicolas Mathieu Rieussec ilk bağımsız kronografı icat etti. Rieussec'in cihazı, at
yarışları sırasında geçen süreyi işaretlemek için kadran yüzeyinde mürekkep damlaları kullandı; bu
mekanizmayı ilk gerçek geçen zaman ölçüm cihazı haline getirdi.

1862

### Adolphe Nicole'ün Kalp Parçası

Adolphe Nicole kalp parçalı kamın patentini alarak saat yapımında devrim yarattı. Bu mühendislik
atılımı, kronograf ibrelerinin anında sıfırlanmasına olanak tanıdı ve modern kronometre sıfırlama
fonksiyonunun temelini attı.

1932

### Olimpik Hassas Zamanlama

İsviçreli üretici Omega, Olimpiyat Oyunları zamanlaması için 1/5 saniye hassasiyetine sahip
kronograf mekanizmalarını tanıttı. Bu, profesyonel spor kronometresinin küresel ölçekte
standardizasyonunun başlangıcı oldu.

1970s

### Dijital Kuvars Çağı

Kuvars bazlı elektronik kronometreler, mekanik yayları tamamen ortadan kaldırarak benzeri görülmemiş
1/100 saniyelik (10 milisaniye) doğruluk elde etti. Uluslararası Ağırlık ve Ölçü Bürosu (BIPM),
dijital hassas zamanlama için resmi uluslararası standartlar oluşturdu.

1990s

### Yaygın Tüketici Benimseme

LCD üretimindeki ilerlemeler, dijital kronometrelerin ekonomik ve kompakt olmasını sağlayarak eğitim
amaçlı fiziksel programlarda, mutfak ortamlarında ve tüketiciye yönelik spor etkinliklerinde
evrensel olarak benimsenmesine yol açtı.

2010+

### Tarayıcı Tabanlı Yerel Araçlar

Hassas zamanlamaya fiziksel cihazlar olmadan erişilebilmesini sağlayan çevrimiçi kronometre araçları
ortaya çıktı. TheKronometre.com, milisaniyenin altındaki dahili doğruluk için son derece duyarlı 10
ms'lik görsel ekranla birlikte gelişmiş modern tarayıcı API'lerini kullanır.

## Online Kronometre Nasıl Kullanılır?

Bu kronometre aracını kullanmak için eksiksiz bir zamanlama oturumu için şu 5 adımı izleyin.

### Temel Kullanım: Adım Adım

1
▶

#### Başlat

Zamanlama başlatmak için **BAŞLAT** butonuna tıklayın veya klavyenizde Boşluk (Space) tuşuna basın.

2
🏁

#### Tur Kaydet

**TUR** butonuna veya L tuşuna basın. Her tur, bireysel tur süresini ve kümülatif bölüm süresini
görüntüler.

3
⏸

#### Duraklat

Duraklatmak için tekrar Boşluk tuşuna basın (**Duraklat**). Devam etmek için bir kez daha Boşluk
tuşuna basın (**Devam et**).

4
↺

#### Sıfırla

Kronometreyi sıfıra döndürmek için R tuşuna basın veya **SIFIRLA** butonuna tıklayın.

5
📄

#### Veri Dışa Aktar

Tüm tur kayıtlarını dışa aktarmak için **CSV İndir** butonuna tıklayın. Dosyayı Excel, Google Sheets
veya LibreOffice Calc'ta açın.

çalışan tarayıcı tabanlı bir dijital kronometredir.** Online kronometre araçları, tarayıcı
penceresinde doğrudan milisaniye hassasiyeti sunmak için cihazın yüksek çözünürlüklü performans
zamanlayıcısını kullanır.

TheKronometre.com, telefon tabanlı kronometre uygulamalarına göre 6 avantaj sunar: sıfır kurulum,
depolama alanı kullanmama, otomatik güncellemeler, Android, iOS, Windows ve macOS genelinde çapraz
platform uyumluluğu, klavye kısayolu desteği ve tam masaüstü ekran kullanımı. Online kronometre
Chrome, Safari, Firefox ve Edge'de çalışır.

## Kronometre Geçmişi

1821

### Nicolas Mathieu Rieussec

Fransız saatçi Nicolas Mathieu Rieussec ilk bağımsız kronografı icat etti. Rieussec'in cihazı, at
yarışları sırasında geçen süreyi işaretlemek için kadran yüzeyinde mürekkep damlaları kullandı; bu
mekanizmayı ilk gerçek geçen zaman ölçüm cihazı haline getirdi.

1862

### Adolphe Nicole'ün Kalp Parçası

Adolphe Nicole kalp parçalı kamın patentini alarak saat yapımında devrim yarattı. Bu mühendislik
atılımı, kronograf ibrelerinin anında sıfırlanmasına olanak tanıdı ve modern kronometre sıfırlama
fonksiyonunun temelini attı.

1932

### Olimpik Hassas Zamanlama

İsviçreli üretici Omega, Olimpiyat Oyunları zamanlaması için 1/5 saniye hassasiyetine sahip
kronograf mekanizmalarını tanıttı. Bu, profesyonel spor kronometresinin küresel ölçekte
standardizasyonunun başlangıcı oldu.

1970s

### Dijital Kuvars Çağı

Kuvars bazlı elektronik kronometreler, mekanik yayları tamamen ortadan kaldırarak benzeri görülmemiş
1/100 saniyelik (10 milisaniye) doğruluk elde etti. Uluslararası Ağırlık ve Ölçü Bürosu (BIPM),
dijital hassas zamanlama için resmi uluslararası standartlar oluşturdu.

1990s

### Yaygın Tüketici Benimseme

LCD üretimindeki ilerlemeler, dijital kronometrelerin ekonomik ve kompakt olmasını sağlayarak eğitim
amaçlı fiziksel programlarda, mutfak ortamlarında ve tüketiciye yönelik spor etkinliklerinde
evrensel olarak benimsenmesine yol açtı.

2010+

### Tarayıcı Tabanlı Yerel Araçlar

Hassas zamanlamaya fiziksel cihazlar olmadan erişilebilmesini sağlayan çevrimiçi kronometre araçları
ortaya çıktı. TheKronometre.com, milisaniyenin altındaki dahili doğruluk için son derece duyarlı 10
ms'lik görsel ekranla birlikte gelişmiş modern tarayıcı API'lerini kullanır.

## Online Kronometre Nasıl Kullanılır?

Bu kronometre aracını kullanmak için eksiksiz bir zamanlama oturumu için şu 5 adımı izleyin.

### Temel Kullanım: Adım Adım

1
▶

#### Başlat

Zamanlama başlatmak için **BAŞLAT** butonuna tıklayın veya klavyenizde Boşluk (Space) tuşuna basın.

2
🏁

#### Tur Kaydet

**TUR** butonuna veya L tuşuna basın. Her tur, bireysel tur süresini ve kümülatif bölüm süresini
görüntüler.

3
⏸

#### Duraklat

Duraklatmak için tekrar Boşluk tuşuna basın (**Duraklat**). Devam etmek için bir kez daha Boşluk
tuşuna basın (**Devam et**).

4
↺

#### Sıfırla

Kronometreyi sıfıra döndürmek için R tuşuna basın veya **SIFIRLA** butonuna tıklayın.

📄

laboratuvar deneyleri sırasında pratiktir.

## Kullanım Alanları

Bir dijital kronometre, spor, eğitim, yemek pişirme, verimlilik ve bilimsel araştırma olmak üzere 5
temel kullanım alanına hizmet eder.

🏃 Spor ve Atletizm 📚 Eğitim ve Sınav Hazırlığı 🍳 Mutfak ve Yemek Pişirme ⏱ Verimlilik ve
Odaklanma Çalışması 🔬 Bilim ve Araştırma

### 🏃 Spor ve Atletizm

Koşu, yüzme, bisiklet ve kürek sporlarında **bölüm süresi (split time)** takibi, performans
analizinin temelidir. World Athletics teknik kurallarına göre resmi müsabaka zamanlaması için 1/100
saniye (10 milisaniye) hassasiyet zorunludur.

Sporcular ve antrenörler, her aralık için tur sürelerini kaydetmek, antrenman seanslarını
karşılaştırmak ve uzun vadeli performans takibi için CSV verisi dışa aktarmak amacıyla online
kronometreyi kullanır. Türkiye Atletizm Federasyonu (TAF), lisanslı yarışma antrenmanları için
dijital ölçüm araçlarını teşvik etmektedir.

### 📚 Eğitim ve Sınav Hazırlığı

Zaman yönetimi sınav başarısını belirler. Türkiye'nin YKS sınav sisteminde TYT, öğrencilerin 135
dakikada (8.100 saniye) 120 soruyu tamamlamasını gerektirir — soru başına ortalama 67,5 saniye.

Deneme sınavlarında her bölüm başında **TUR** tuşuna basarak bölüm sürelerini kaydedin. Her çalışma
oturumundan sonra bölüm bazlı analiz için CSV dosyasını dışa aktarın. Pomodoro tekniği — 25 dakika
odaklanarak çalışma, 5 dakika mola — KPSS, DGS ve ALES hazırlığında kronometre ile etkili bir
şekilde uygulanır.

### 🍳 Mutfak ve Yemek Pişirme

Pişirme hassasiyeti zamanlamaya bağlıdır. Makarna tam olarak 8 dakikada (480 saniye), ±30 saniye
içinde al dente kıvamına ulaşır. Şeker, 15 saniyelik bir pencere içinde karamelden yanığa dönüşür.
Fransız patisserie ve İtalyan mutfağı saniye düzeyinde doğruluk gerektirir.

Kronometrenin tur kaydı işlevi, birden fazla pişirme aşamasını eş zamanlı olarak takip eder — toplam
geçen süreyi kaybetmeden her adımı kaydeder. Sesli uyarılar süre dolduğunda bildirir, ekrana bakma
ihtiyacını ortadan kaldırır.

### ⏱ Verimlilik ve Odaklanma Çalışması

**Pomodoro** Tekniği, İtalyan yazar Francesco Cirillo tarafından 1980'lerin sonunda geliştirilmiş
olup, çalışmayı 25 dakikalık odaklanma seansları ve 5 dakikalık molalar şeklinde yapılandırır. Bu
yöntem erteleme alışkanlığını azaltır ve tutarlı çıktıyı korur.

Kronometreyi başlatın, 25 dakika çalışın, ardından mola dönemi için sıfırlayın. Serbest çalışanlar
ve uzaktan çalışanlar, tamamlanan Pomodoro döngülerini kaydetmek ve iş günü boyunca toplam verimli
saatleri takip etmek için tur kaydıyla kronometreyi kullanır.

### 🔬 Bilim ve Araştırma

Laboratuvar deneyleri, reaksiyon süresi ölçümleri ve gözlem protokolleri, milisaniye çözünürlüğünde
hassas zaman ölçümü gerektirir. Sarkaç salınım ölçümleri, kimyasal reaksiyon zamanlaması ve insan
tepki süresi çalışmaları, dışa aktarılabilir verilerle tarayıcı tabanlı hassas zamanlamadan
yararlanır.

Kronometrenin **CSV Dışa Aktarma** özelliği, araştırmacıların ve üniversite öğrencilerinin zamanlama
verilerini doğrudan analiz programlarına aktarmasını sağlar. Dışa aktarılan her dosya tur numarası,
toplam süre ve bölünmüş süre (split time) bilgilerini içerir.

TheKronometre.com, 6 profesyonel düzeyde özellik sunar. Tümü ücretsizdir, kayıt veya ödeme
gerektirmez.

⏱

### Milisaniye Hassasiyeti

Cihazınızın yüksek çözünürlüklü performans zamanlayıcısını kullanarak 10ms görüntü çözünürlüğü.
Doğruluk, telefon tabanlı kronometre uygulamalarının çoğunu aşar.

🏁
